Name: Novaroma Season Icons
Author: JestingDart4369
Description: 1,923 icons for your keys in five seasonal colour themes (Default, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter), each in light, dark and burgundy. 104 symbols for system, development, media, audio and study, plus 12 on/off pairs (bulb, lamp, plug, TV, speaker and more) for smart-home toggles. Made with the help of AI (Claude by Anthropic) and reviewed by the author.
